prompt:
Independent blind pairwise review of 15m tree authoring previews, NOT native game renders. Do not infer authoring method or prefer complexity. Image groups: Gleditsia reference photo1, candidates2/3/4; Tilia reference5, candidates6/7/8; Ulmus reference9, candidates10/11/12. Photos establish broad crown/foliage character, not a pixel matching or photorealism target. Treat background, lighting and the Gleditsia Sunburst cultivar colour as nuisance differences. Judge canopy texture at gameplay scale, silhouette, card visibility, plausible leaf scale and genus character. Strong normal maps can make leaves look like shingles; do not reward detail just because it exists.

For these pairs return first/second/tie/abstain with a short concrete reason: [2,3],[3,2],[3,4],[4,3],[6,7],[7,6],[7,8],[8,7],[10,11],[11,10],[11,12],[12,11]. Reversed order must not change the underlying preference. A candidate can lose for unusable foliage even if its texture has more detail. Do not award a botanical or native-quality pass. Return JSON {"pairs":[{"images":[...],"choice":"...","reason":"..."}],"limitations":[...]}.
